record_audits.conflict_context: Primary paper supports the Spiniferin(E4R) sequence, C-terminal amidation, and MIC values, but APD6-only similarity percentages/internal APD analysis are not primary-source claims.
record_audits.database_note: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is 92.31% similar to Spiniferin I: 31%; K: 23%; L=G: 15%. Obtained by changing E4 to R. Chemical modification: C-terminal amidation. Activity: Active against Gram- E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 6.25 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 27736 (MIC 50 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC BAA-427 (MIC 25 uM), S. aureus ATCC 25923 or MRSA ATCC 33591 (MIC 6.25 uM).
